'''Watto's Podracer''' had surprisingly good repairing and cooling, accelerated quickly, and was structurally sound, however it had a lower top speed and didn't handle well in comparison to some of the other top [[Podracer/Legends|Podracers]]. Still, [[Watto/Legends|Watto]] claimed it was the best in the [[Galaxy/Legends|galaxy]].
